column1: Nuclear cost, three tiers: keep it, model it, build it
Real 2025 USD/MWh unless stated (annual-average market FX, Fed H.10; deflated with US CPI-U). Excludes VAT.

Grey band = 2025 short-run marginal cost of existing gas plant in the UK and Germany (fuel plus carbon, 46–55% efficiency; as in section 8). Benchmark tier at a harmonised 7% real cost of capital. Barakah = own calculation on the same basis as Vogtle (7%, 60 years, 90% capacity factor, NEA operating and fuel cost), on a capital cost of $24.4bn (2016 financing close) to $32bn (later reported total). China: $85 here (NEA at 7%, 2018 data restated) is the top of the $72–85 range in section 8, whose low end is the IEA estimate on recent cost data and IEA financing assumptions. LWR/ALWR = (advanced) light-water reactor; VVER = Russian pressurised-water design. Sources. OECD/NEA Projected Costs 2020 (benchmarks, life extension); NAO 2026 (Hinkley C contracted price); own calculation from Georgia Power and MEAG disclosures (Vogtle, 7%, 60 years); Cour des comptes 2025 (Flamanville, 7%, 85% capacity factor); ENEC 2016 and IAEA PRIS (Barakah); Radiant Energy Group 2026 (German restart, advocacy-adjacent).
